Software updates to v2.0 are scheduled February-May 2024 on a phased basis (~10 aircraft/month). For the specific aircraft G-ABCD, the status is flagged as non-compliant with the deadline not yet reached, with installation scheduled April 22-23, 2024, and the aircraft remains airworthy under MCAS v1.7.3 until the deadline. Under 14 CFR Part 39, operators of 737-8 and 737-9 aircraft are legally required to comply with all applicable ADs, and non-compliance renders the aircraft unairworthy for operation under FAA jurisdiction.
